title.en: Reading concrete pump integral piston φ230 with the section names of Synchronous motor
title.zh: 用来源页《Synchronous motor》的章节名来读concrete pump integral piston φ230

description.en: Synchronous motor provides the section names for concrete pump integral piston φ230. A φ230 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ230 as its piston.
description.zh: 《Synchronous motor》为concrete pump integral piston φ230提供章节名。φ230 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ230 写成自己的活塞。

h1.en: concrete pump integral piston φ230 without figures beyond the row, under Synchronous motor
h1.zh: concrete pump integral piston φ230不超出已印行，标题来自《Synchronous motor》

directAnswer.en: concrete pump integral piston φ230 is restated below in Hebei Pinjin Machinery’s own catalogue words. The section order is the order of Synchronous motor, and that page is not a second nameplate. A φ230 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ230 as its piston.
directAnswer.zh: concrete pump integral piston φ230下面用河北品锦机械目录里已经有的说法重述。章节次序来自《Synchronous motor》，那一页不是第二块铭牌。 φ230 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ230 写成自己的活塞。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Types”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. The integral piston page lists φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250, sold per piece, as replacement parts rather than OEM parts of other brands. This note is only φ230. Rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane are printed on the split-piston page, not as a material for this integral row. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The split-piston page also lists φ230, with its own material row and a set as the unit. Same outer diameter does not merge the two parts. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“类型”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 整体活塞页列出 φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250，按个供货，并写明是替换件，不是其他品牌原厂件。本文只写 φ230。橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯印在分体活塞页上，不是这一整体活塞行的材料。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。分体活塞页也有 φ230，那边有自己的材料行，单位是套。外径相同也不会把两件配件并成一件。 标题到此为止。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Control techniques”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write integral piston, φ230, and the quantity in pieces. Do not add a material the page does not print. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“控制工艺”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明整体活塞、φ230 和个数。不要补上页面没有印的材料。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Synchronous speed”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. A φ230 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ230 as its piston. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 来源页在“来源章节：Synchronous speed”处分开叙述。这一节沿用该标题，底下只重复邢台已经印出的说法。 φ230 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ230 写成自己的活塞。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Construction”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“构造”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Operation”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“操作”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 标题到此为止。

body.en: “Starting methods” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: “起动方法”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

heading.zh: 用途, 专用性能, 与优点

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Applications, special properties, and advantages”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 来源页在“用途, 专用性能, 与优点”处分开叙述。这一节沿用该标题，底下只重复邢台已经印出的说法。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 标题到此为止。

body.en: “Subtypes” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 整体活塞 page plus this size and the quantity. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synchronous_motor
body.zh: “来源章节：Subtypes”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明整体活塞这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synchronous_motor
